title: SE implementation scratchpad - Cedar Vale Bank
content:
Purpose: working scratchpad for Cedar Vale Bank Dedicated deployment. Quick notes, action items, config snippets, questions for infra and security. NOT final; share relevant bits to Confluence when stable.

Customer context:
- Cedar Vale Bank (regional bank) wants Private/Dedicated deployment in us-east-1.
- Compliance: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS, monthly audits, no public egress for inference traffic.
- Expected Q1 traffic: steady 45 qps peak, occasional spikes to 120 qps. Latency SLO: 95th < 200ms for generation baseline.

High-level goals:
- Provision Dedicated pool in us-east-1 with 2x p4d nodes initially, autoscale to 6 on sustained load.
- Private VPC deployment with VPC peering to customer network, use customer-provided KMS key for secrets and model keys.
- Setup routing policies to fall back to hosted smaller model if capacity constrained.

Immediate TODOs (short-term):
- [ ] Confirm allowed CIDR ranges and peering request owner (customer contacts: Adam Chen).
- [ ] Get KMS key ARN and IAM principal to add to access policy.
- [ ] Open JIRA-SE-4021: infra request for dedicated GPU pool + subnet sizing (add CPU buffer).
- [ ] Provision test tenant and create smoke test harness (see github PR 189).
- [ ] Schedule walkthrough with security team (Nora) to confirm no egress requirement details.

Config notes / snippets for ops team:
- VPC / networking:
  - Customer VPC CIDR: 10.64.0.0/16 (pending confirmation)
  - Redwood private subnet plan: 10.64.32.0/22 (dedicated compute), 10.64.36.0/24 (management)
  - Required ports: outbound to customer internal only; inbound only from customer VPN IPs on 443 for ALB; health checks from Redwood control plane IPs (list in Confluence page).
  - NAT: set up NAT gateway in management subnet for outbound control plane calls only; restrict egress to control plane endpoints.

- KMS: customer-managed key required. Need to add Redwood service principal arn:aws:iam::redwood-service:role/redwood-kms-access to key policy. Confirm key alias and rotation policy.

- SSO / Identities:
  - Use customer Okta SAML for admin access to console. Add roles: se-admin, se-observer.
  - Service account for infra provisioning: se-deploy-cedarvale@redwood-svc (needs kms encrypt/decrypt + ec2 describe permissions in us-east-1).

- Model and runtime config:
  - Initial models: open Llama-2-13b-ggml (quantized) for throughput testing, fallback to 7b for cost-sensitive routes.
  - KV cache warmup: pre-warm common prefixes for banking prompts in test harness.
  - Batching policy: target latency 150ms at 45 qps -> sustained batch target 16 tokens/batch; tune via Redwood Optimize suggestions.

Tests / Acceptance criteria:
- Smoke test: end-to-end inference from customer network -> confirm TLS mutual if required -> no public egress -> generation latency <200ms 95th percentile on 45 qps load.
- Security: KMS access validated, audit logs flow to customer's SIEM (via syslog endpoint).
- Rollout: Canary 10% traffic for 48h, check errors/regressions, then 100% if stable.

Deployment steps (rough):
1) Get signed network peering and KMS policy from customer.
2) Create infra ticket and provision VPC/subnets/ALB/security groups.
3) Provision Dedicated pool, attach to subnets, verify instance profiles.
4) Deploy test model, run synthetic load, capture telemetry.
5) Configure routing and canary rules in Console -> start canary.
6) Run acceptance tests, hand off to customer ops.

Open questions / blockers:
- Customer expects zero egress, but requires external vendor telemetry (new relic). Do we allow selective egress to New Relic endpoints? Need security sign-off.
- Confirm SLA and overage policy for spikes above reserved capacity. Add to contract addendum.
- KMS key ARN and exact IAM principal to add to key policy.

Meeting notes (2026-02-20 sync with customer, 10:00am):
- Adam Chen confirmed initial CIDR and Okta contact.
- Security asks: monthly rotated keys + customer's SIEM integration.
- Action: send network template by EOD 2026-02-21 (assigned to Miguel).

Quick checklist for next sync:
- [ ] Miguel to send network template (by 2026-02-21) - pending
- [ ] Priya to draft KMS policy snippet and share with customer security - in progress
- [ ] I (Sam) to open infra provisioning ticket once KMS ARN received - blocked

Notes to self:
- Keep copies of all policies in Confluence under cedar-vale-architecture. This doc is ephemeral; move stable bits to Confluence later.
- Keep performance harness logs in github under se/perf/cedar-vale. PR 189 contains initial harness.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: customer changes CIDR post-provisioning -> mitigation: request locked window and change control process.
- Risk: KMS policy mistakes -> mitigation: run dry-run script and have security review before enabling.

Next steps (this week):
- Push test harness to staging, run basic smoke tests.
- Get KMS ARN and open infra ticket JIRA-SE-4021.
- Prep canary rollout plan and failure rollback steps.

End of scratchpad. Will prune and transfer to Confluence when steady state achieved.
